notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed small bugs:

[list]
[*]In some cases the Start button would not work on the gamepad, this should be fixed now
[*]In some cases you could not go right when using a gamepad, this will be fixed for future players, some of you might have to go inside the settings menu and rebind this key manually for now.
[/list]

Thanks everyone ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Quick patch for a quick bug:

[list]
[*]If you had the item "Last-aid Kit" and did not get enough ingredients at the end of the wave from it to make a potion, the game would freeze
[*]Also improved the wording of the english tutorial
[/list]

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: My Life as an Alchemist now out on Steam
notes.notes:
After months of hard work I'm so happy to announce that My Life as an Alchemist is now out on Steam ːsteamhappyː

I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I do, please consider leaving a review if you do ːsteamthumbsupː

Please let me know in the Steam forum if you find any bug that needs to be fixed, I'll be happy to do so!
